by Kate Tsurkan
Giant flags of Moldova and the EU are seen on the Government buildings in Chisinau, Sept. 26, 2025. (Daniel Mihailescu/AFP via Getty Images)
Yet another series of Russian drone incursions into Moldova's airspace was recorded during the latest overnight attack against Ukraine, Moldova's Defense Ministry reported on Oct. 16.
Between 11:02 p.m. on Oct. 15 and 3:46 a.m. local time on Oct. 16, Moldova's Defense Ministry s aid three Russian drones crossed into the country's territory before returning to Ukraine's airspace.
A fourth drone entered at 5:59 a.m. and reentered again at 6:09 a.m. before turning back to Ukraine.
The incidents underscore the growing security risks posed to Moldova and the region by Russia's war against neighboring Ukraine.

Letecký provoz v Itálii narušily technické problémy v síti pro přenos dat, která zajišťuje služby řízení letového provozu. Společnost ENAV, která v zemi zajišťuje navigační služby, proto snížila na polovinu počet letadel, která mohou být odbavena v jejím vzdušném prostoru. Problémy způsobily zpoždění a rušení letů na letištích po celé zemi.
Foto: Profimedia.cz
Letadlo přistávající v Palermu.
Článek

ENAV uvedla, že závadu odhalila v noci a zpočátku se jí dařilo udržet běžný provoz díky záložním systémům. S rostoucím ranním provozem a přetrvávajícími problémy však musela omezit počet letů.

President Vladimir Putin signed a decree Thursday placing the Russian assets of five major Western manufacturing companies under the temporary management of a little-known firm owned by an ex-official who fought in Ukraine.
The targeted European and U.S. assets include French flooring giant Tarkett, Belgian hygiene manufacturer Ontex Ru, German plastic packager Menshen, corrugated producer Kappa Rus and metal packaging producer Eviosys, a subsidiary of the U.S. Sonoco Products Company.
Their combined 2025 revenue exceeds 53 billion rubles ($633.2 million), with Tarkett accounting for 19.3 billion rubles, Kappa Rus 16.5 billion rubles, Ontex Ru 10.3 billion rubles, and Eviosys and Menshen 6.1 billion rubles and 1.4 billion rubles, respectively.
Putin’s decree hands management rights to Tsentr Kapital Management Company, a Moscow entity established in February 2026, according to corporate registry data cited by RBC.

Flugverkehr über Italien gestört
Stand: 16.10.2026 • 11:55 Uhr
In Italien gibt es massive Probleme im Flugverkehr. Betroffen sind Starts und Landungen im ganzen Land, aber auch Überflüge. Grund sind Störungen bei der Flugsicherung. Ein Hackerangriff oder Sabotage wird derzeit ausgeschlossen.
Wegen Störungen im Datenübertragungsnetz der Flugsicherungsdienste ist der Flugverkehr über Italien seit mehreren Stunden beeinträchtigt. Dies teilte die Flugsicherung Enav in Rom mit. Seit 6 Uhr seien deshalb "Maßnahmen zur Verkehrssteuerung" in Kraft.
Heute können nur ungefähr halb so viele Flüge abgefertigt werden wie üblich. Betroffen ist ganz Italien und auch Überflüge über das Land. Einen Hackerangriff oder Sabotage schloss die Behörde zunächst aus.

titulekPuvodni: Weapons thieves arrested getting some fast food in Daugavpils, Latvia
shrnuti: Shortly after stealing two firearms from a range in Daugavpils, the thieves were apprehended at a fast-food restaurant in Daugavpils and taken into custody, according to the State Police.

Authors:
LSM English (Latvian Public Media)
Shortly after stealing two firearms from a range in Daugavpils, the thieves were apprehended at a fast-food restaurant in Daugavpils and taken into custody, according to the State Police.
At around 11:40 am on 27 September, officers from the Latgale Regional Directorate of the State Police received a report of the theft of two firearms from the premises of a shooting range in Daugavpils. Extensive resources were deployed in the search operation, including officers from the State Police Special Tasks Battalion and officers from the Daugavpils Municipal Police.
The suspected perpetrators were arrested by officers from the Daugavpils Municipal Police at a fast-food restaurant, where the stolen firearms were also found in their possession. The court imposed a preventive measure – remand in custody – on both individuals.

Oekraïne hervat aanvallen op Russische oliesector, Rusland meldt aanval op raffinaderij
Deel dit artikel
Oekraïne heeft na drie dagen van pauze de aanvallen op de Russische energiesector hervat. President Zelensky kondigde in een interview met Britse krant Financial Times aan dat het tijdelijke stopzetten van bombardementen officieel voorbij is. Afgelopen nacht is volgens Russische autoriteiten al een droneaanval uitgevoerd op een olieraffinaderij in de regio Rjazan, in het westen van het land.
"De aanvalspauze is afgelopen", zei Zelensky tegen Financial Times. "Dat heb ik het leger gezegd nadat er weer mensen zijn omgekomen bij Russische aanvallen."
Zelensky kwam tot dit besluit omdat het Kremlin zich al niet aan het bestand hield dat Trump afgelopen zondag plotsklaps aankondigde. De Amerikaanse president zei toen dat Rusland en Oekraïne elkaars energiesector zouden ontzien bij aanvallen over en weer, als onderdeel van een dieseldeal die hij had gesloten met het Kremlin.

The European Commission wants to create a European Security Council to better prepare the bloc for sabotage and external threats. In her State of the Union speech, President Ursula von der Leyen supported the plan as the EU’s answer to sabotage, cyberattacks and drone incursions from Russia. “Europe needs its own counter-hybrid playbook,” she said.

Skip to main content

BRUSSELS — The European Commission's cybersecurity division is rolling out a plan to use artificial intelligence to respond to high-risk cyberattacks, according to a document obtained by POLITICO.
The undated document, written by the Commission's IT department , sets out how to prepare the EU executive’s cyber defenses for “emerging AI-driven threats.” It proposes an action plan to shore up defenses in light of AI, with the most urgent move being the speed of response to attacks.
Governments have rushed to grapple with the rising threat brought by AI's ability to expose and exploit cybersecurity vulnerabilities. Incidents like OpenAI's accidental intrusion into Hugging Face have prompted calls, including at the highest political level , to be more wary of advanced AI models.

Being able to respond quickly to cyberattacks is most crucial in “high-risk scenarios,” the EU executive’s internal cyber defenders warned, saying that the ability to detect an attack is “not sufficient if containment measures cannot be taken quickly enough.”

Syněhubov oznámil, že Rusové v pondělí v pozdních večerních hodinách zaútočili na civilní infrastrukturu Charkova deseti střelami. Zasáhli několik bytových a rodinných domů. V troskách byla do rána objevena čtyři těla.

The French navy intercepted and boarded an oil tanker linked to Russia’s so-called shadow fleet in the Indian Ocean, President Emmanuel Macron announced Monday.
The French joint staff said naval inspectors boarded the vessel to verify its nationality after doubts arose over its claimed Benin registration. The operation took place around 450 nautical miles south of Réunion Island, an overseas territory of France.
Macron said the ship — the DF Peak — was suspected of sailing under a false flag and being involved in illicit fuel transportation. The vessel is under U.S., EU, U.K. and Ukrainian sanctions.
The tanker was being escorted to Réunion for further checks, said armed forces minister Catherine Vautrin.
The DF Peak is at least the sixth shadow-fleet tanker French authorities have detained over the past year, according to the exiled outlet The Insider.

France seizes Russian ‘shadow fleet’ oil tanker in Indian Ocean — Meduza
Skip to main content
France seizes Russian ‘shadow fleet’ oil tanker in Indian Ocean
October 13, 2026, 7:22 am
Source: Emmanuel Macron
France’s navy detained an oil tanker called the DF Peak that belongs to the “shadow fleet” on October 12, French President Emmanuel Macron said.
The tanker was detained more than 450 nautical miles south of Réunion Island in the Indian Ocean. Authorities suspect it was flying a false flag and illegally transporting fuel.
According to  data from Marinetraffic, the tanker was sailing under Benin’s flag and was headed to the port of Cruz Grande in Chile. It wasn’t clear where the vessel had sailed from.
The magazine Maritime Executive writes that the tanker was built in 2006 and originally belonged to the company Sovcomflot, sailing under the name NS Captain . It was renamed Kaliningrad in 2024 and took its current name in 2025. Its operator is now a company based in Hong Kong.
Maritime Executive also says that Benin’s national registry, whose flag the tanker flies, was once “considered a haven for Russia-linked shadow fleet vessels.” The U.S. sanctioned the tanker in February…

A residential building damaged in a Russian attack on Kharkiv, on Oct. 12, 2026. (State Emergency Service of Ukraine/Telegram)
Russian forces launched a large-scale missile attack on Kharkiv on Oct. 12, injuring at least 11 people, including an emergency responder, and damaging residential buildings across the city, according to Ukrainian authorities.
Three people trapped beneath the rubble were later rescued, UNIAN reported , citing Ukraine's State Emergency Service.
Kharkiv Oblast Governor Oleh Syniehubov said Russian forces had reportedly used 10 Banderol-type missiles in the attack, targeting civilian infrastructure.
In the city's Kholodnohirskyi district, a strike hit a four-story residential building, destroying an entire section. At least 10 nearby private houses were also damaged, Syniehubov said.

RFE/RL’s Balkan Service and the investigative project Sistema have identified a diplomat at the Russian Embassy in Serbia who was declared persona non grata in Bulgaria in 2021 during an investigation into explosions at weapons depots.

Hundreds of French supermarkets have been hit by a cyber attack that caused their fridges and freezers to heat up, spoiling fresh and frozen food estimated to be worth millions of euros.
Hackers reportedly gained control of the software that regulates the temperatures of the refrigeration units, forcing some to warm to 50C (120F) overnight.
The chief executive of Coopérative U said several of its supermarkets had been hit by the "extremely serious and unprecedented" attack.
More than 100 of the chain's supermarkets were targeted, while at least 300 stores from Intermarché and its Netto brand were affected, according to the AFP news agency.
Intermarché said its fridges had heated up to 50C for six hours overnight into Monday, and the retailer had thrown away all the affected food to avoid health risks, the Reuters news agency reported.
Some supermarket staff reportedly said they were hit by waves of hot air when they opened freezer units on Monday morning.

First proposed by European Commission President Ursula von der Leyen this September, the European Security Council is supposed to bring EU leaders and key allies together, including the UK, Norway, Ukraine and Canada. The goal is to coordinate faster on security threats that affect the continent.

shrnuti: Russia launched 121 drones and a Kh-59 air-to-surface missile overnight, with impacts recorded at 15 locations and debris falling at four others.

Ukraine destroys or jams 89 Russian drones in overnight attack, including 55 jet-powered UAVs | Ukrainska Pravda
Stock Photo: Anti-Aircraft Missile Regiment named after Kryvonis
Russia attacked Ukraine with a Kh-59 air-to-surface missile from airspace over the Black Sea and 121 drones on the night of 11-12 October. Ukraine's air defences have downed 89 drones.
Source: Ukraine's Air Force
Details: The Russians used Shahed (76 jet-powered) and Gerbera attack drones, Banderol/Dan-T drone-launched cruise missiles and Parodiya decoy drones launched from the Russian cities of Oryol, Kursk and Primorsko-Akhtarsk as well as from temporarily occupied Donetsk Oblast and Hvardiiske in Crimea.
Advertisement:





Early reports indicated that as of 09:00, Ukrainian air defence forces had destroyed or jammed 89 Shahed (55 jet-powered), Gerbera and other types of drones.
Hits by aerial assets have been recorded at 15 locations and downed aerial assets (debris) landed at four locations.
The Air Force warned that the Russian attack is ongoing.

On today’s show, Zoya Sheftalovich and Ian Wishart discuss how EU ambassadors have been meeting in recent weeks to discuss what to do if a potential Russian hybrid attack were to result in mass casualties.
Next, Britain’s minister in charge of relations with Europe, Hamish Falconer, is making his first official visit to the European Parliament. Zoya was able to catch him on the phone to ask him more about EU-U.K. relations under PM Andy Burnham and a potential deal on farming, among other things, currently in the works.

Germany arrests former domestic intelligence chief over alleged spying
August Hanning served as president of Federal Intelligence Service from 1998 to 2005
Germany’s federal prosecutor’s office has said a former domestic intelligence chief was arrested on Tuesday on espionage allegations.
August Hanning served as president of the Federal Intelligence Service (BND) from December 1998 to November 2005.
Hanning was arrested in Bad Toelz-Wolfratshausen, in southern Germany. A former aide of his, identified only as Manfred D, was also arrested on Tuesday.
The prosecutor’s office did not reveal who the men were suspected of spying for.

K útoku došlo v úterý 29. září ráno na základní škole ve Staškově. Třináctiletý žák osmé třídy se během první vyučovací hodiny skrýval na toaletě. Poté zaútočil na chodbě nožem. Cílem útoku byla jeho spolužačka Nela.

shrnuti: Russian FPV drone strikes killed a woman and injured four others, including medical personnel, in targeted attacks on Kramatorsk on 5 October.

vyrez.text:
Russian drone strikes hit ambulances and housing in Kramatorsk | Ukrainska Pravda
Photo: Donetsk Oblast Prosecutor's Office
One woman has been killed and four people have been injured after Russian FPV drones struck ambulances and a multi-storey apartment building in the city of Kramatorsk in Donetsk Oblast.
Source: Donetsk Oblast Prosecutor's Office
Details: In the evening of 5 October, between 22:00 and 22:25, the Russians targeted ambulances parked on one of Kramatorsk's streets with two FPV drones. Three of the medical staff received bodily injuries while attempting to save the cars following the first hit.
Advertisement:





The men were diagnosed with blast trauma, shrapnel wounds to the torso and limbs, burns and concussion. The injured received medical treatment, prosecutors noted.
Three ambulances were damaged.
Additionally, at 22:10, the Russians hit a multi-storey apartment building with a drone. A 49-year-old woman was killed and another 68-year-old woman sustained a broken foot and shrapnel wounds to the torso and limbs and was suffering from concussion.





Photo: Donetsk Oblast Prosecutor's Office

shrnuti: The vessel's captain was killed and 11 crew members were rescued after the attack on the Turkish-owned ship, Ukraine's leader says.

Image source, Romanian Interior Ministry via REUTERS
Image caption, The fire-damaged vessel was pictured after Romanian authorities launched a rescue mission
By Paulin Kola
Published
5 October 2026
Ukraine's President Volodymyr Zelensky has condemned a "horrific" Russian attack on a vessel carrying corn in the Black Sea.
The ship's captain was killed in the strike involving two drones, Zelensky said, and another sailor was unaccounted for. Eleven crew members - nationals of Azerbaijan and India - have been rescued.
Romania said it had mounted a rescue mission after "a fire on the ship Royad Mammadov" outside the country's territorial waters. It said two people had died.
Russia has not commented, but its defence ministry earlier said it had struck two cargo vessels. Russia has been pounding Ukrainian infrastructure in what it says is retaliation for Ukrainian attacks on Russian oil refineries and ships in the Black Sea.
Monday's attack by Russia targeted "a civilian vessel in neutral waters carrying corn and owned by Turkey", Volodymyr Zelensky said.

Moscow police detained around 60 people on Sunday during a Communist Party rally commemorating the 1993 constitutional crisis, after the event spiraled into a protest against alleged fraud during last month’s parliamentary elections.
An estimated 2,000 people gathered for an annual memorial honoring those killed during an Oct. 4, 1993, standoff when President Boris Yeltsin ordered tanks to shell the Supreme Soviet parliament building to dissolve opposition to his administration.
Eyewitnesses told the Telegram news channel Ostorozhno Novosti that police officers charged into the crowd after chants of slogans like “Down with the Tsar!” “Freedom for political prisoners!” and “For fair elections!” broke out against the ruling United Russia party.

LSM English (Latvian Public Media)
On Saturday, October 3rd, in Krāslava municipality, border guards—in cooperation with soldiers from the National Armed Forces—detained a Latvian citizen who was transporting individuals who had illegally crossed the state border, according to a State Border Guard release.
Soldiers from the National Armed Forces, who are providing support to border guards, stopped a Chrysler vehicle driven by a Latvian citizen in Andrupene Parish. Upon inspection of the vehicle, five individuals were found inside who lacked valid travel documents, visas, or residence permits and who had previously crossed the Belarus-Latvia border illegally.
Criminal proceedings have been initiated against the driver for the illegal transportation of a person across the state border. Five individuals were registered as having been prevented from illegally crossing the state border in accordance with Section 4 of the State Border Guard…

Moscow police detained about 60 people at an authorized Communist Party rally on Oct. 4 after participants began chanting anti-Kremlin slogans, according to the party and Russian rights group OVD-Info.
The rally marked the anniversary of Russia's 1993 constitutional crisis, when a standoff between President Boris Yeltsin and hard-line lawmakers culminated in the military shelling the parliament building in Moscow.  Authorities said 123 people were killed, while unofficial estimates put the toll in the hundreds.

The plane crashed near the village of Krasnoyarovo. Initial reports said six crew members were killed during a training flight from the Ukrainka air base.
A post about the unveiling of a memorial to the dead pilots later appeared on the “Rural News” community page for Seryshevo, a village in the Amur region where the Ukrainka air base is located. OSINT analyst duke garland noticed the post. Mediazona verified the information and found that all eight of those killed had served in strategic aviation.

A bomb destroyed a car belonging to a participant in Russia’s war against Ukraine on October 2 in Novomoskovsk, in Russia’s Tula region, the Ukrainian monitoring Telegram channel Exilenova+ reported.
The bomb had been planted under the car’s chassis, according to  data from the anonymous Russian Telegram channel VChK-OGPU. The driver killed was identified as Roman Syromyatnikov, and the Novomoskovsk-based news outlet Novomoskovsk Segodnya confirmed the death of a person by that name.
Syromyatnikov worked at Russia’s Federal Penitentiary Service (FSIN) facilities in the Tula region during the 2010s. He signed a contract with Russia’s Defense Ministry in 2023 and returned to the Tula region for medical treatment in late 2024, the independent Russian investigative outlet iStories reported , citing leaked data.

Začíná se mluvit o tom, že do verbování „dobrovolníků“ se zapojují i kriminální gangy.

Ukrajinské útoky na pozemní cestu na Krym pokračují, Rusové prý proto začali převážet kanystry s palivem v menších autech.
Mapa dne: Kde tlačí Rusové a kde Ukrajinci.

BRUSSELS — It was meant to be a debate on how to curb Europe’s soaring energy prices.
But the first session of talks at an EU leaders' summit in Brussels Thursday quickly descended into a three-hour fight over whether the EU should put a carbon price on driving cars and heating buildings.
The delay got so bad, the roast veal and fig tartlet lunch awaiting European leaders was driven well into the afternoon.
